source_backbone: Kew POWO/WCVP 2026; Kew-cited Hardion et al. 2012 (Taxon 61:1217-1226); US Forest Service FEIS as older contrasting rank treatment
synonym_and_rank_caution: Kew recognizes 37 synonyms of A. donax; historical A. donax subsp. plinii belongs to separately accepted A. plinii. Multiple historical variegata author citations and var. versicolor are species synonyms, not currently accepted varieties.
native_range_audit: DEFERRED — NOT REVIEWED; no county/native fields changed
photo_and_specimen_identity: HOLD — no individual observation or archived photo certified
hybrid_provenance: HOLD — no clone, cultivar or hybrid parentage inferred
install_decision: Retain existing canonical giant reed; historical aliases research-only. No installation, card, photo, genus, native range, or Pages changes.

decisions.subject: Arundo donax L. (1753)
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain accepted Poaceae species and L. authority; canonical name already correct.
decisions.detail: Kew POWO/WCVP accepted at species rank.

decisions.subject: Arundo genus circumscription
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve separately accepted Arundo species; genus currently lists five accepted species.
decisions.detail: Genus list includes donaciformis, donax, formosana, micrantha, plinii.

decisions.subject: Arundo plinii Turra (1765)
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain as a separately accepted species; not an alias of A. donax.
decisions.detail: Taxon concept distinction backed by Hardion et al. 2012 cited by Kew.

decisions.subject: Arundo donax subsp. plinii (Turra) Mateo & Figuerola (1987)
decisions.proposed_decision: Resolve historical cross-rank name to accepted Arundo plinii Turra, not A. donax.
decisions.detail: Homotypic synonym of separately accepted A. plinii.

decisions.subject: Arundo hellenica Danin, Raus & H.Scholz (2002)
decisions.proposed_decision: Resolve to accepted Arundo plinii; preserve original name for historical search.
decisions.detail: Kew cites Hardion et al. 2012 for current concept.

decisions.subject: Cynodon donax (L.) Raspail (1825)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map homotypic combination to accepted Arundo donax.
decisions.detail: Homotypic cross-genus synonym, not Cynodon dactylon.

decisions.subject: Donax arundinaceus P.Beauv. (1812)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map homotypic historical name to accepted Arundo donax.
decisions.detail: Do not create separate Donax card.

decisions.subject: Scolochloa donax (L.) Gaudin (1828)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map homotypic combination to accepted Arundo donax.
decisions.detail: Preserve original author and genus as searchable alias.

decisions.subject: Arundo bengalensis Retz. (1789)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map heterotypic historical synonym to accepted Arundo donax.
decisions.detail: Not an accepted separate Arundo species under Kew 2026.

decisions.subject: Arundo sativa Lam. (1779)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map heterotypic historical synonym to accepted Arundo donax.
decisions.detail: Preserve authorship.

decisions.subject: Arundo donax var. barbigera (Honda) Ohwi (1941)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical variety to accepted Arundo donax species; do not invent accepted infraspecific card.
decisions.detail: Synonym, not an accepted variety in POWO.

decisions.subject: Arundo donax var. coleotricha Hack. (1899)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical variety to accepted Arundo donax species.
decisions.detail: Synonym under Kew 2026.

decisions.subject: Arundo donax var. versicolor (Mill.) Aiton (1789)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical variety to accepted Arundo donax; retain cultivar/variegation context separately from rank.
decisions.detail: USFS older treatment mentions a variety; Kew synonymizes it at species rank.

decisions.subject: Arundo donax var. variegata (Poit. & A.Vilm.; Endl.; E.Vilm.)
decisions.proposed_decision: Record three author-qualified historical combinations as Kew synonyms of A. donax; do not equate them to one nomenclatural publication.
decisions.detail: Distinct original author strings/publications must remain distinct even when accepted destination agrees.

decisions.subject: Arundo latifolia Salisb. and Donax donax (L.) Asch. & Graebn.
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve nomenclatural qualifiers: A. latifolia illegitimate superfluous; Donax donax not validly published.
decisions.detail: Nomenclatural synonyms are not independently accepted taxa.

decisions.subject: Merge Arundo plinii into Arundo donax based on historical subspecies
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject this synonym merge; current Kew recognizes A. plinii as accepted.
decisions.detail: Potential duplicate/incorrect concept assignment.

decisions.subject: Promote A. donax var. barbigera, coleotricha, versicolor, variegata to accepted taxa
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject automatic infraspecific card creation; current Kew treats these as synonyms.
decisions.detail: Older flora variety usage does not override current accepted-rank backbone.

decisions.subject: Treat Donax donax (L.) Asch. & Graebn. as a valid accepted combination
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject because Kew explicitly marks it not validly published.
decisions.detail: Keep historical string searchable with validity qualifier.

decisions.subject: Existing individual Arundo donax photographs and specimens
decisions.proposed_decision: Do not certify individual source/photo identification or Arundo-versus-Phragmites diagnosis from name audit.
decisions.detail: Photo and voucher identity remain independent scientific checks; no media edits.

decisions.subject: Variegated horticultural material, clone origin and hybrid provenance
decisions.proposed_decision: Do not infer cultivar identity, clone lineage or hybrid ancestry for any individual without evidence.
decisions.detail: Historic versicolor/variegata names do not prove provenance or genetic parentage.

decisions.subject: Authorless Arundo donax var. variegata records
decisions.proposed_decision: Leave original authorship, publication and exact cultivated concept unresolved until source/voucher is available.
decisions.detail: Kew lists Poit. & A.Vilm., Endl., and E.Vilm. separately; authorless record cannot be uniquely assigned.
